item.title: EU recovery funds fuel frenzied restorations around Rome, including at famed basilica
item.description: ROME (AP) — Some of the lesser-known treasures at San Pietro in Vincoli basilica in Rome , known for Michelangelo’s massive marble statue of Moses, are finally being restored.

item.title: NHL roundup: Kempe scores in overtime to lift Kings to 5-4 win over Blue Jackets
item.description: COLUMBUS, Ohio (AP) — Adrian Kempe scored his second goal of the game with 1:26 left in overtime to give the Los Angeles Kings a 5-4 win over the Columbus Blue Jackets on Monday.

item.description: MILAN (AP) — The Rev. Paolo Venturelli never gets too close when he visits Leonardo da Vinci’s “The Last Supper.

item.title: Iran launches new attacks at Gulf Arab countries as it keeps up pressure on the region
item.description: DUBAI, United Arab Emirates (AP) — Iran launched new attacks Tuesday at Gulf Arab countries as it keeps up pressure on the region, while five pro-Iranian militants were killed by an airstrike in northern Iraq.

item.title: FAA grounds all JetBlue flights after request from airline
item.description: NEW YORK (AP) — The Federal Aviation Administration has grounded all JetBlue flights due to a request from the airline, the agency said Tuesday. The ground stop impacts flights to all destinations, according to the advisory.

item.title: Australia grants asylum to 5 members of the Iranian women's soccer team
item.description: GOLD COAST, Australia (AP) — Australia granted asylum to five members of the Iranian women’s soccer team who were visiting the country for a tournament when the Iran war began, a government minister said Tuesday.
